name: Crown of Rime
intendedUse: Roguelike shop and equipped relic icon
catalogSource: Current user-requested Runeblade demo rules in packages/content/runeblade.ts; older catalog effects superseded
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated Runelord Runeblade inventory relic icon. The supplied knight is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, do not depict a character. Match serious 2D cel-shading, broad flat regions, two or three crisp hard shadow tones, chunky silhouette, steel gray, deep navy, bone ivory and ice cyan. Quiet surfaces, few large functional details, strong dark contours, no PBR realism, no painterly gradients, no bloom or decorative clutter. Square canvas, whole object centered with generous clear padding; genuine transparent background, no frame, scenery, text, lettering or watermark. Must read clearly at 128px. Subject: An ancient open steel circlet with three broad angular upward points, the middle tallest, large faceted pale cyan ice crystals fused into those points, deep navy recesses and one bright cyan diamond jewel centered at brow. Entire circlet in slight three-quarter view. Chills enemies at battle start.

visualQA.fullSize: Passed: complete distinct silhouette, serious steel/navy/cyan cel shading, no scenery or text
visualQA.nativeSize: Passed at 128px on dark and ivory backgrounds: distinct silhouettes, clean alpha edges, readable central symbols; narrow banner is intentionally slender.
